Advanced Materials for Health and Rehabilitation # Medical yarn for PPE and health care textiles Far Infrared Thermal Fabric Medical yarns are essential in the production of textiles for personal protective equipment (PPE), rehabilitation gear, and a variety of health care applications. These specialized yarns are engineered to provide antibacterial properties, helping to prevent contamination and ensuring compliance with strict regulatory standards for safety and performance.
Fabrics used in sport braces and support products require a unique combination of strength, insulation, and comfort. They must be durable enough to provide support, yet breathable and capable of suppressing bacterial growth and odors caused by perspiration.
Far Infrared Thermal Fabric # Far Infrared Thermal Fabric is crafted using medical yarns embedded with microelements. These microelements absorb energy from sunlight or body heat and release it as far-infrared rays. Often referred to as “functional yarn,” this material is designed to gently warm the body, accelerate blood flow, increase blood oxygen levels, activate body functions, and help relieve pain and swelling.
Sport Support and Rehabilitation Braces # Textiles for sport braces and rehabilitation supports must balance comfort with effective support, especially since they are often worn for extended periods. Far-infrared rays, as incorporated in these fabrics, have been shown to promote circulation. During clinical treatment and recovery, the body absorbs low-density energy, which is transmitted to deep tissues as heat resonance. This process can enhance circulation, increase blood flow, inhibit inflammation, and support wound healing.
Acelon’s AceVitality® medical yarn, with its embedded far-infrared microelements, is particularly well-suited for health care and sports applications. The material is highly stable, maintaining its beneficial properties even after repeated washing.
Integrated Product Design and Manufacturing # Acelon leverages modern production facilities equipped with a Manufacturing Execution System (MES) to track and document every stage of the manufacturing process. From product design and raw material sourcing to final production and shipping, this system ensures efficiency and consistent product quality. As a result, Acelon is able to offer a comprehensive range of high-quality medical yarn products at competitive prices, serving industries in over 40 countries. Customized and special material orders are welcome.

In addition, Acelon’s “ANTISTATIC PET” draw textured yarns provide significant anti-static properties. These yarns help dissipate electrical charges, reducing the risk of static sparks that could pose fire hazards. The anti-static feature also minimizes dust adhesion, keeping fabrics cleaner for longer periods and enhancing wearer comfort by preventing static cling.

Innovative Yarns for Active Performance # Functional yarns for sportswear Functional yarns play a crucial role in the fabrics used across a wide range of athletic and outdoor activities. Whether it’s hiking, climbing, skiing, camping, swimming, or yoga, the right fabric can make a significant difference in comfort and protection. Durable and flexible textiles ensure freedom of movement, while specialized yarns provide targeted benefits such as thermal retention in cold environments and moisture management during intense activities.
Elastic Sportswear # When engaging in sports or exercise, comfort and freedom of movement are essential. Stretch fabrics crafted from elastic yarns are designed to support easy movement, simple care, and, most importantly, a comfortable fit. High-performance, well-designed fabrics not only offer an attractive appearance but also deliver substantial functional advantages. As a supplier of elastic yarns, we recognize the importance of flexibility in sports applications, making these yarns an ideal choice for activewear.
Elastic sportswear for flexibility Indoor Sports # For indoor activities such as training, running, yoga, and gym workouts, apparel must be comfortable, breathable, and flexible. Uncomfortable clothing can hinder performance, especially during activities like yoga. Breathable and moisture-wicking materials are essential for managing sweat and maintaining comfort. Acelon AceIce® cooling yarn and AceCool® moisture-wicking yarn are engineered to provide an instant cooling sensation that surpasses traditional cotton and other yarns. Additionally, AceHygeia® antibacterial yarns help protect against microbial growth and odors, ensuring a fresh, dry, and comfortable experience.
Indoor sportswear with cooling and antibacterial yarns Outdoor Sports # Outdoor activities like hiking and climbing demand clothing that is both durable and protective against the elements, while still allowing for comfortable movement. Windproof jackets, coats, and mountain climbing apparel made with advanced yarns such as Acelon’s abrasion-resistant nylon DuraXtend® and AceVitality® thermal yarn offer resilience and lightweight performance. Fabric developers often enhance these textiles with breathable, wind- and water-resistant finishes. Flexibility remains a priority, making elastic yarns a suitable choice for outdoor wear.
Outdoor sportswear with durable and thermal yarns Commitment to Eco-Friendly Solutions # At Acelon, environmental responsibility is a core value. Our eco friendly yarn production processes adhere to the highest standards, and we are proud to offer recycled and bio-based NY and PET yarns that contribute positively to environmental sustainability.
Experience and Capabilities # Since 1988, Acelon has been recognized as a leading international manufacturer of high-quality, high-performance elastic yarns. For further information or to discuss your flexible yarn requirements, we invite you to contact us.

Outdoor yarns for furniture applications Yarn Materials for Outdoor Use # Nylon, polyester (PET), and polypropylene (PP) dope dyed yarns are among the most suitable choices for outdoor furniture. These materials are recognized for their excellent color fastness, even when exposed to prolonged sunlight. Their hydrophobic properties also make them highly resistant to moisture, helping to prevent deterioration and extend the lifespan of outdoor products.
Applications: From Patios to Cafés # Dope dyed color yarns are ideal for a variety of outdoor applications, including:
Patio furniture Beach umbrellas Café awnings Fabric seat covers For beach umbrellas, these yarns offer durability against wind, rain, and sunlight. In retractable café awnings, their vibrant colors and resilience enhance both function and aesthetics. When used in patio furniture and seat covers, they provide comfort, support, and enduring style.
Dope dyed yarns in outdoor settings Eco-Friendly Yarn Innovations # Acelon’s AceColor® Eco PET recycled, dope dyed color yarns are produced from recycled PET bottles. This approach gives new life to materials that would otherwise contribute to waste and pollution, reducing the carbon footprint and conserving petroleum resources. Polyester yarn, in particular, stands out for its versatility and environmental benefits, as it is made from recycled sources and is well-suited for outdoor use.
Advanced Manufacturing and Quality Assurance # Acelon is equipped with world-class production facilities and a state-of-the-art Precision Instruments Lab. The lab features advanced R&D equipment, including a Scanning Electron Microscope and Differential Scanning Calorimeter. Continuous development and rigorous testing—such as particle size, thermal, rheology, elemental, and optical analyses—ensure that every yarn product meets high standards of functionality and quality.
Whether you require fine yarns for apparel or robust yarns for outdoor applications, Acelon is prepared to collaborate on innovative solutions tailored to your needs.

Leisure wear plays a vital role in our daily lives, offering comfort, protection, warmth, and a touch of style. A diverse range of yarns is available to meet these needs, ensuring that daily apparel remains both functional and appealing.
Leisure Wear and Daily Clothes # For leisure clothing, comfort is paramount, even as style and appearance remain important. Nylon 6 yarn stands out as a highly suitable option for leisure wear, available in three main variations: NY6 Flat Yarn, Draw Textured Yarn, and Air Textured Yarn. These can be combined to create textiles with a variety of lusters and functionalities, making them a popular choice for everyday clothing.
Nylon 6 yarns for versatile leisure wear Underwear and Stockings # Lingerie and underwear crafted from nylon or polyester yarns deliver excellent comfort. Polyester, in particular, is soft, warm, lightweight, and features effective moisture-wicking properties, drying quickly for added convenience. Socks and stockings must provide comfort and protection, while also being breathable to manage moisture and heat, reducing odor. For colder conditions, warmth is essential. Polyester socks excel in all these areas—they are durable, resistant to stretching and wrinkling, easy to wash, quick to dry, soft to the touch, and maintain vibrant colors.

Acelon’s Recycled Polyester Yarns (AceEco® rPET) and Recycled Nylon Yarns (AceEco® rNY) are all GRS certified, supporting responsible manufacturing practices.
GRS certified recycled yarns Bio-Based Nylon Yarn Innovations # Acelon’s nylon yarn manufacturers have developed AceEco® Bio410, a bio-based nylon yarn produced from castor oil-derived materials. Composed of 70% bio-based content, AceEco® Bio410 utilizes renewable resources, reducing reliance on nonrenewable petroleum and significantly lowering the carbon footprint of nylon yarn production.
Versatility and Experience # With over three decades of expertise in designing and manufacturing fabric yarns for clothing, Acelon offers a broad selection of high-quality yarns through its advanced preproduction facilities. Commitment to Sustainable Fiber Innovation # Acelon Chemicals & Fiber Corporation was established in 1988 by a group of partners united by their passion and vision for the textile industry. Over the years, the company has experienced steady growth, expanding its operations from 1988 to 2009. Today, Acelon operates three manufacturing facilities located in Puyan, Fangyuan, and Douliu, specializing in the production of nylon and polyester yarns.
Recognizing the increasing importance of environmental sustainability, Acelon has actively invested in green technologies. In 2011, the company founded Acegreen Eco-Material Technology Co., Ltd., followed by Acenature Biotechnology Co., Ltd. in 2013. These subsidiaries focus on green cellulosic fiber technology and the development of finished household products made from yarns produced by affiliated companies, enabling Acelon to reach a broader customer base and expand its market presence.
Acelon’s yarns are distributed worldwide and are utilized across a diverse range of end markets, including ready-made garments, outdoor functional products, household goods, and industrial applications. In addition to offering standard nylon and polyester raw white yarns, Acelon has developed a series of functional and environmental fibers to address evolving market needs and environmental challenges.
One of the company’s key innovations is the production of dope-dyed fibers, which significantly reduce the need for traditional dyeing and finishing processes. This advancement helps customers lower their carbon dioxide emissions and wastewater output. Furthermore, Acelon offers recycled nylon yarns and biodegradable nylons, both made from renewable resources, contributing to waste reduction and lessening environmental impact.
Acelon is dedicated to continuous improvement in textile technology, integrating environmental protection into its core business philosophy. The company remains agile in the face of global competition and the dynamic needs of the textile industry, consistently adjusting its growth strategies over more than three decades. As a recognized leader in new fiber materials, Acelon is committed to developing eco-friendly products, driving innovation, and strengthening its core competencies to deliver greater value to customers. Meeting customer needs remains the driving force behind the company’s ongoing progress.

利害關係人鑑別流程 # 公司由CSR報告書編輯小組依據AA 1000利害關係人議合標準(SES)五大原則，透過問卷調查等方式，鑑別出七大類主要利害關係人。重大議題及利害關係人類別均經高階管理階層核可，確保決策具代表性與前瞻性。
利害關係人鑑別流程 永續議題鑑別與重大性分析 # 參考全球永續性報告協會（GRI）發布之GRI準則，經內部討論後篩選出15項永續議題，並依「利害關係人關注程度」及「對公司營運衝擊程度」進行高、中、低三強度分析，最終鑑別出7項高強度重大性議題。

社會責任與永續發展目標 # 本公司始終秉持回饋社會的理念，近年來主要贊助對象涵蓋弱勢團體及在地社區的非營利與公益組織，透過定期與不定期的經費或物資捐助，積極參與產學合作，培育紡織產業未來的技術與管理人才。
永續發展具體目標 # E（環境）：減碳量、用水量、廢棄物量各下降30%（以民國109年度~119年度為基準）。 S（社會）：與利害關係人共好共榮，設立良好溝通管道，持續開發友善環境的環保纖維。 G（治理）：誠信透明的公司治理。 在地實踐與社區共融 # 協助在地小學圖書館建置 支持彰化縣埔鹽鄉永樂國小圖書館建設，培養偏鄉孩童閱讀習慣，並開放社區人士借閱，目標打造「社區閱讀中心」。 長期資助弱勢學生 與家扶中心、扶輪社合作，長期捐助在地學校弱勢學生，於校慶活動提供自產產品及畢業典禮贈送圖書禮券（本年度約41份），鼓勵學子勤奮向學。 支持在地文化活動 自107年度起固定贊助二水跑水節，113年度提供5萬元經費及6000片口罩，提升台灣國際能見度。 贊助社團協會活動 113年度贊助埔鹽、芳苑消防隊及社區社團活動禮品，提供公司成品禮盒（約800份）。 舉辦捐血活動 113年度與彰化西南扶輪社及新竹捐血中心合辦捐血活動，捐贈500盒口罩。 產學合作與青年培育 # 產學攜手合作計劃 自110年度起參與教育部「產學攜手合作計劃－紡織纖維科技專班」，與沙鹿高工紡織科、勤益科大化材系合作，累計8人次參與，為期4年（至民國113.08），113.12-117.11進入下一階段，現有5人參與。透過理論與實務並行，培養研發潛力與人才，提升產品附加價值與管理績效，促進學術與實務交流。 青年教育與就業儲蓄帳戶方案 響應教育部技職司計劃，鼓勵高中職應屆畢業生透過職場、學習及國際體驗探索人生規劃。累計8人次參與，協助青年適才適性發展，提供職業試探機會，建立正確職業價值觀。 公益參與與社會關懷 # 愛的書庫 # 聚隆公司及董事長周文東先生長期支持台灣閱讀基金會「共讀分享，智慧循環」理念，自民國102年度起持續贊助彰化縣在地學校「愛的書庫」書箱更新計畫，累計流通圖書總量104萬餘本，總閱讀人次突破5790萬。
